Recovery-only state = data in RAM, WAL records on disk, **no open WAL handle**.\n\n**Why the data is readable (and still durable) at that point.** Reads are served from memory: `doc_count()` counts `doc_ids_` (`:589-600`); `scan()` merges `persist_stores_` with `memory_store_` (`:2825-2841`); `Stats()` includes the writing segment whenever `doc_count() > 0` (`collection.cc:403-442`, `:2076-2082`).
